title: Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Decent front‑of‑house audience recording with thin bass and vocal echo, but captures a strong US Festival performance praised for its high energy.
ai_review.review: The show is described as solid and typical of the Dead’s powerful touring period in the early ’80s, with reviewers calling it fantastic despite no specific song highlights. The front‑of‑house (FOB) audience recording is decent—better than many crowd tapes—but suffers from a thin bass response, some vocal echo and a lack of punch due to the large stadium acoustics.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are uniformly enthusiastic about the performance (70% weight) with only modest criticism of recording clarity (30% weight), resulting in a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bass sounds thin, vocals have echo, and overall punch is reduced by the stadium PA; however, clarity is comparable to many audience recordings on the site.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set reflects a strong touring form of the era, maintaining momentum and energy throughout the performance.
